title: Kenny Omega’s belt-collector invasion
summary: AEW champion Kenny Omega enters Impact’s world-title picture with Don Callis at his side. His victory over Rich Swann puts the championship in an outsider’s hands until Christian Cage ends his reign.

chapters.title: Omega wins the title-versus-title match
chapters.result: Omega defeats Rich Swann to take the Impact world championship.
chapters.context: The AEW champion leaves with both companies’ world titles, turning the crossover into a struggle over Impact’s top prize.

chapters.title: Christian ends Omega’s Impact reign
chapters.result: Christian Cage defeats Omega for the Impact championship.
chapters.context: The title changes hands on AEW’s first Rampage. This milestone belongs to Impact’s championship story even though the match takes place in another promotion.
